summary: Builds the season results/leaderboard UI menu. It resets UI state, then descends the season data structure (prevyear -> grid -> drivers/times linked lists). When the drivers and times lists have matching counts it iterates both, pairs each driver name with its race time using a separator from byte_5EA438, and creates one UI menu item per pair via UIMenuItemCreator.

operations.description: Initialize the local format buffer: zero v11/v12, copy byte_5EA438[0] into v10 as the separator prefix, and stash this in v13.
Reset UI state with StateCleanupNotification(this) before building the menu.
Populate the buffer length header via StrlenOverwrite(&v10).
Locate the season races data section with SeasonRacesSectionFinder(0), rooted at unk_8AC368.
If the season section was not found, return the null result.
Descend the 'prevyear' key with StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(result, aPrevyear).
If the prevyear node is null, return.
Descend the 'grid' key with StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(result, aGrid_1) and keep it as v2.
If the grid node is null, return.
Descend 'drivers' from grid into v3 and 'times' from grid into result with StringKeyedLinkedListSearch.
If either the drivers list or the times list is null, return.
Compute the drivers and times list counts with LinkedListCount; proceed only when the two counts match.
Iterate index v5 from 0 over the driver count in a do-while loop, reloading LinkedListCount(v3) as the bound.
Fetch the driver node v6 and the time node v7 for index v5 via NullCheckWrapper.
If either node is null, skip formatting for this index.
Extract the string entries with DataEntryAccessor on both nodes.
Build the menu label with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v14, "%s%s%s", driver, separator, time).
Create the UI menu item with UIMenuItemCreator(v13, v14, 0, 0, 0, 0).
Increment v5; the loop continues while v5 is below the reloaded drivers count.
Return the final search result pointer (null on any early exit).
